observations: Godin & Thivierge PLOS Computational Biology 2026 remains the active SPLiT source. The article explicitly exposes S1 Code as DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 and states that the estimated basis tracks the empirical activity subspace rather than the imposed structural subspace.

Read-only recovery of the S1 Code ZIP was retried through the public article/supporting-information route. The current transport still did not yield file-level ZIP contents; no mutation or probe side effect was used.

bounded_audit.scope: Synthetic bounded causal control continuing the prior full-online identity-drift audit. This is not an exact reproduction of SPLiT or any neuroscience experiment.

design.observations: Two drifting Gaussian prototype streams with sparse noisy semantic identity cues and cause-dependent event durations. Prototype trajectories can cross; cue availability can disappear around the crossing; duration semantics and event priors can also swap.
design.prototype_tracker: Two unlabeled constant-velocity/Kalman-like prototype tracks. When predicted tracks approach, an explicit permutation hazard reduces confidence that track identity preserves semantic identity.
design.two_hypothesis_filter: Maintains the two track-to-semantic assignments A=S/B=C versus A=C/B=S while keeping the original semantic duration model fixed.
design.joint_four_hypothesis_filter: Maintains four joint hypotheses: two track-to-semantic assignments times two duration regimes (normal versus swapped). Sparse semantic cues update only semantic mapping; event durations update the joint mapping-duration posterior; track proximity raises only the mapping-permutation hazard. Semantic decisions marginalize across hypotheses rather than forcing a label when assignment is ambiguous.
design.evaluation: 64 paired held-out seeds, 800 events per seed for the primary paired comparisons. Paired bootstrap 95% intervals are over seed-level differences.
design.memory_proxy: Fast-tracker memory action receives +1 utility for a correct temporary-silence admission and -1.5 for stale admission during persistent change; slow-tracker proxy uses +0.25/-1.0. This utility is a diagnostic proxy, not a reproduction of the prior angular-error tracker experiment.

permutation_detector_two_hypothesis.interpretation: Explicitly admitting semantic label permutation when physical prototype tracks become indistinguishable prevents a confidently stale label assignment from surviving a crossing, especially when semantic cues temporarily disappear.

prototype_crossing_only.interpretation: Always carrying a duration-regime switch hypothesis is unnecessarily conservative when duration semantics are actually stable.

cue_loss_only.interpretation: The joint model suppresses many correct admissions when cues vanish but the duration semantics remain valid.

mixed_crossing_plus_duration_swap_plus_p.interpretation: A semantic-permutation detector alone is insufficient when the duration-to-semantic mapping also changes. Maintaining an independent duration-regime hypothesis prevents the stale duration prior from relabeling persistent changes as temporary silence.

shared_duration_abstention_probe.rule: When semantic assignment confidence is low, replace label-specific duration likelihood with a shared duration hazard while retaining the mapping posterior rather than forcing semantic probability to 0.5.
shared_duration_abstention_probe.crossing_and_cue_loss_effect: Slightly worsened Brier because stable duration statistics are legitimate identity evidence in those regimes.
shared_duration_abstention_probe.mixed_and_duration_swap_effect: Modestly improved Brier because stale label-specific duration evidence is harmful.
shared_duration_abstention_probe.interpretation: Semantic ambiguity alone is not a sufficient reason to discard duration evidence. Duration evidence should be disabled only when its own semantic assignment is uncertain or has changed.

mechanistic_interpretation.positive: The prior audit's prototype-crossing failure can be separated into two distinct label-switching problems. A mapping-permutation hypothesis protects against loss of semantic identity when drifting prototypes cross. A separate duration-regime hypothesis is required when temporal statistics themselves change semantic meaning. Marginalizing these hypotheses is much safer than forcing a single semantic label and then letting a stale duration prior drive memory restoration.
mechanistic_interpretation.negative_boundary: The fully joint filter pays an avoidable uncertainty cost when duration semantics are stable, especially during long cue loss. Therefore duration-switch flexibility should not be permanently active at full strength. A higher-level posterior-predictive gate should decide when the duration-regime hypothesis is worth activating; otherwise use the simpler permutation-aware mapping model.
mechanistic_interpretation.identifiability: When mapping and duration labels are simultaneously permutation-equivalent and no independent semantic cue is present, semantic identity remains unidentifiable. The correct action is abstention/shared semantics rather than confident relabeling.
mechanistic_interpretation.tracker_scope: The current memory results use a transparent utility proxy. The prior role-local audit already showed that slow Oja-like trackers can be harmed by dormant-memory restoration; this run does not overturn that boundary.

limits: Synthetic Gaussian prototypes and geometric event-duration distributions.
Prototype tracker and permutation hazard are source-derived engineering controls, not biological models or SPLiT code.
The joint filter uses a fixed duration-switch hazard; it is not yet a learned posterior-predictive change detector.
The current memory result is a utility proxy rather than a direct rerun of the PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like angular-error controllers.
SPLiT S1 Code.zip remains unrecovered at file level.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Build a hybrid semantic controller that runs the low-cost two-hypothesis mapping-permutation filter by default and activates the joint duration-regime hypothesis only when a calibrated posterior-predictive duration-change score indicates semantic duration drift. Calibrate activation/deactivation on disjoint matched and duration-stable cue-loss streams so matched/crossing performance is preserved, then test mixed duration/prototype/prior shifts with larger held-out seeds and exact cue loss/recovery. Replace fixed duration-switch hazard with online evidence accumulation plus hysteresis and explicit label-symmetry abstention. Then feed the guarded posterior back into the actual fast PAST/GROUSE-like and slow Oja-like dormant-memory controllers, using tracker-specific admission/restore policy and requiring simultaneous improvement in post-silence recovery and post-switch interference before retaining the memory mechanism. Preserve exact tested scope and a nonempty frontier.
